item.title: Long Island's Surprising Week: Crime, Closures, and Comebacks
item.description:
A straw discarded decades ago just helped solve a Long Island murder that went cold for more than 40 years. That single piece of plastic — and the DNA clinging to it — is a reminder that this stretch of New York rarely stays quiet for long.

Quick Summary: This week on Long Island, a decades-old murder case broke open thanks to DNA evidence, the Gilgo Beach serial killer investigation produced new bombshell revelations, Planet Fitness expanded while Wren Kitchens collapsed, and a hit-and-run driver targeting geese is rattling local communities. Here’s what it all means.
